records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The iliohypogastric nerve supplies skin over which of the following regions:
records.explanation: The iliohypogastric nerve is formed from the anterior rami of L1. It innervates the internal oblique and the transversus abdominis muscles and supplies posterolateral gluteal skin and skin over the pubic region. Vv

records.stem: Which of the following structures does NOT pass through the inguinal canal:
records.explanation: The inferior epigastric artery does not pass through the inguinal canal. The inguinal canal contains: e the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve (within the spermatic cord in men) e the spermatic cord in men e the round ligament in women e the ilioinguinal nerve (passes through part of the canal, exiting the superficial inguinal ring with the other contents) Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The superficial inguinal ring is an ‘opening’ in which of the following structures:
records.explanation: The superficial inguinal ring is a triangular opening in the aponeurosis of the external oblique, with its apex pointing superolaterally and its base formed by the pubic crest. ; Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The sacrum articulates with which of the following structures:
options: Ischium of the pelvic bone 19% () ium of the pelvic bone 69%
records.explanation: The pelvic bones articulate posteriorly with the sacrum at the sacroiliac joints and with each other anteriorly at the pubic symphysis. The sacrum also articulates superiorly with vertebra L5 at the lumbosacral joints and inferiorly with the coccyx at the sacrococcygeal joint. Vv
